questions.content: Câu 1: Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful sentence. late/go/now/home/should/you/ it’s/and
options: A. It’s you should go late and home now.
B. It’s late you and should go home now.
C. It’s late and you should go home now.
D. It’s should go home and you late now.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc đúng: “It’s late” (đã muộn rồi) + “and” (và) + “you should go home now” (bạn nên về nhà bây giờ). Dịch nghĩa: Trời đã muộn và bạn nên về nhà ngay.

questions.content: Câu 2: Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful sentence. give/the present/tomorrow/we/him/will
options: A. Tomorrow we will give him the present.
B. We will tomorrow give hime present the.
C. Tomorrow we give will hime the present.
D. Tomorrow we will give the present him.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Thứ tự đúng của câu có trạng từ thời gian đứng đầu: ADV + S + V + O. Dịch nghĩa: Ngày mai chúng ta sẽ tặng anh ấy món quà.

questions.content: Câu 3: Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful sentence. have/at the station/her/we/just met
options: A. We just have met her at the station.
B. We have just met her at the station.
C. We have met just her at the station.
D. We have just her met at the station.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Cấu trúc thì hiện tại hoàn thành với trạng từ “just” đặt giữa have và V3 Dịch nghĩa: Chúng tôi vừa mới gặp cô ấy ở nhà ga.

questions.content: Câu 4: Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful sentence. he/unhealthy/was/last week/./he/in hospital/looks
options: A. He looks in hospital. He was unhealthy last week.
B. He unhealthy. He was looks in hospital last week.
C. He looks unhealthy. He was in hospital last week.
D. He looks unhealhy. He was hospital in last week.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc đúng: look + ADJ (trông như thế nào) Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy trông không khỏe. Tuần trước anh ấy nằm viện.

questions.content: Câu 5: Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful sentence. weeks/in France/spend/I/will/next year/my holiday/for two
options: A. Next year I spend will my holiday in France for 2 weeks.
B. Next year I will spend in France my holiday for 2 weeks.
C. Next year I will spend for 2 weeks my holiday in France.
D. Next year I will spend my holiday in France for 2 weeks.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Thứ tự đúng của câu có trạng từ thời gian đứng đầu: ADV + S + V + O. Dịch nghĩa: Năm sau tôi sẽ nghỉ ở Pháp trong hai tuần.

questions.content: Câu 6: Rewrite sentences without changing the meaning. “I am sorry but I won’t do the extra work,” Carol said.
options: A. Carol promise not to do the extra work.
B. Carol denied doing the extra work.
C. Carol refused to do the extra work.
D. Carol apologised for doing the extra work.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “refuse to do something” = từ chối làm điều gì đó → diễn đạt lại nghĩa gốc. Dịch nghĩa: Carol từ chối làm thêm công việc.

questions.content: Câu 7: Rewrite sentences without changing the meaning. He prefers sitting at home to playing outside.
options: A. He would rather sit at home than play outside.
B. He hates both sitting at home and playing outside.
C. He plays outside more often than he sits at home.
D. He sometimes plays outside instead of sitting at home.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “prefer doing A to doing B” ↔ “would rather do A than do B” (thích làm gì hơn). Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy thích ngồi ở nhà hơn là chơi bên ngoài.

questions.content: Câu 8: Rewrite sentences without changing the meaning. He won the first prize thanks to his good reaction.
options: A. He won the first prize though he didn’t react well.
B. He thanked his good reaction after he had won the first prize.
C. He wouldn’t have won the first prize without his good reaction.
D. He reacted well because he won the first prize.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc “thanks to” (nhờ có) ↔ “without … would not have …” (câu điều kiện loại 3). Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy đã không thể thắng giải nhất nếu không có phản xạ tốt.
